success.alarm: At least 85% button travel, then below 20%, hand contact and release dwell
success.drawer: Below 2 mm open and 10 mm/s for the dwell
success.laptop: Below 5 degrees and 0.15 rad/s, at least 4 degrees of contact-driven progress, release dwell
success.globe: Within 3 degrees of target and 0.07 rad/s for the release dwell
success.full_sequence: All four task verifications in order, no fall, with drawer/laptop/globe still within terminal position and speed tolerances.

protocol.selection: Stop at update 64 only if both development routes complete all four tasks without falling; otherwise continue to the fixed cap of 96. The selected final checkpoint is frozen before test seeds are unsealed.
protocol.scope: Command-level locomotion and task-profile post-training. Native Unitree gait, classical leg servos and arm IK are fixed. State observations, simulation only.
protocol.uncertainty: Report raw paired scenario outcomes and Wilson intervals; four fresh test seeds are a pilot, not evidence of broad robotics generalization.
protocol.labels: Walking imitates a fixed waypoint policy. Task labels are chosen only from actual MuJoCo training trials. No hidden mass, friction, seed, teacher labels or evaluation outcomes enter the model observation.
protocol.controller_revision: v6-pretrain-final: cached arm recovery, laptop prelift, measured foot contacts
protocol.representation: Independent, documented bins of observed relative target geometry. No teacher action or hidden simulator parameter. Identical encodings reuse the actual Tinker distribution from the same fixed checkpoint.
protocol.walking_sampling: Uniform action class, then uniform unique encoded training observation within class. More repeats are not new physical evidence.
protocol.contact_label_objective: Successful profiles only; choose lowest measured peak force, then duration. Cases without a successful profile are excluded and counted.
protocol.checkpoint_retention: Starting full state is already archived. Every evaluated checkpoint uses real fixed ephemeral inference weights. Persist exactly one new full optimizer state at the development-selected stopping update, 64 or 96.
protocol.prior_study: V6: 64 completed updates, development 0 to 3 waypoints/10, 0 full routes/2; all source records retained. New representation tested against starting weights under the same representation.
protocol.controlled_comparison: Starting and trained policies use identical feature encoding, physics and cache implementation. The comparison measures learning given this engineered representation; no causal claim for encoding versus v6 is made.
protocol.execution: All full-route and navigation evaluation is closed-loop on Modal. Each final before/after/classical triplet shares one worker; no open-loop cross-runtime replay agreement is assumed.

prior_replication.scope: Completed route portion of an ongoing V6 replication; not V7 training or test data.

scope: Command-level locomotion and task-profile post-training. Native Unitree gait, classical leg servos and arm IK are fixed. State observations, simulation only.
evaluation_runtime: All checkpoint and held-out physics executes on Modal. Each held-out before/after/classical triplet shares one worker.
